_comment: Copy this file to trading-limits.json and set your own numbers.
trading-limits.json is gitignored — it never gets committed.
This repo is PUBLIC. Do not put account numbers, balances, or
personal details in either file. Caps only.
The values below are deliberately small. They are a starting point
for finding out what the agent actually does, not a target.
_universe_note: Only tickers listed here may be bought. Keep it to names that are
liquid enough that the spread is a rounding error. No leveraged or
inverse ETFs, no sub-$5 stocks, no recent IPOs, nothing you would
have to look up to explain.
